mechanism: Lock one subject to a single screen-direction destination, then remove traversed route segments monotonically from behind while introducing one instability under the current segment. Alternate local control proof with wide remaining-route proof, and end with the subject fully crossing a safety threshold one beat before the final connection fails.

invariants.rule: Establish one visible destination and one travel direction.
Remove only already-traversed safe space from behind.
invariants.purpose: Prevents arbitrary danger and blocks retreat.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random forward gaps can make survival impossible rather than tense.

invariants.rule: Add one recoverable instability under the current segment.
invariants.purpose: Tests control without replacing route logic.
invariants.ablation_failure: Too many local hazards obscure the monotonic collapse.

invariants.rule: Alternate close control with wide remaining-route evidence.
invariants.purpose: Proves both agency and structural countdown.
invariants.ablation_failure: Only close shots hide how much route remains.

invariants.rule: Cross the full threshold before the last connection fails.
invariants.ablation_failure: Cutting away before full crossing leaves the outcome uncertain.
